filings.ns: Delhivery Limited filed a notice of arbitration with the Singapore International Arbitration Centre on November 27, 2026. The opposing parties are British International Investment PLC, Eaglebay Investment Ltd., and PG Esmeralda Pte. Ltd. The dispute arises from a July 2025 acquisition of Ecom Express Limited. filings.summary: Lupin Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 27, 2026, titled "Lupin Announces U.S. FDA Approval and Launch of Sitagliptin Tablets, USP in the United States".
filings.ns: Lupin Limited announced U.S. FDA approval and launch of Sitagliptin Tablets USP in the United States. The approval follows the Abbreviated New Drug Application. The company launched Sitagliptin Tablets USP in strengths of 25 mg, 50 mg, and 100 mg. These tablets are bioequivalent to Januvia Tablets of Merck Sharp and Dohme LLC. Sitagliptin Tablets USP are indicated for use as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus. Estimated annual sales of the reference listed drug Januvia in the U.S. were USD 2,328.8 million as of September 2026. Lupin Limited is a global pharmaceutical leader headquartered in Mumbai, India. The company has products distributed in over 100 markets. It maintains strong leadership in the U.S. and India across core therapeutic areas.

The company states it is confident to contest the matter. The suit valuation includes 8,200 ESOPs valued at Rs. 3.82 crore. filings.subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Assignment of Bank Rating Excluding Government Support (RXG) by S&P Global Ratings
filings.summary: The Federal Bank  Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
filings.ns: The Federal Bank Limited disclosed that S&P Global Ratings assigned a new Bank Rating Excluding Government Support RXG on November 27, 2026. The assigned ratings are BBB-rxg for long-term and A-3rxg for short-term. This rating evaluates the bank's creditworthiness excluding the impact of extraordinary government support. The existing issuer credit ratings on the banks remain unaffected. The RXG demonstrates that the Federal Bank's investment-grade standing is anchored in its standalone balance-sheet fundamentals, capital adequacy, asset quality, and risk governance. This provides an objective benchmark of standalone credit strength for global institutional investors and debt counterparties. The disclosure is available on spglobal.com/ratings and the bank's website.

filings.ns: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Limited received an order from the Superintendent, Range II, Park Street Division, Kolkata, CBIC, on November 26, 2026. The order imposes a demand of INR 33,83,606 for the period April 2020 to March 2024. The demand includes tax of INR 11,48,959, interest of INR 10,85,688, and penalty of INR 11,48,959. The demand was raised under section 74 of the GST Act, 2017, due to alleged excess Input Tax Credit claimed in GSTR 3B and short payment of taxes under reverse charge. filings.name: TVS Motor Company Limited
filings.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
filings.summary: TVS Motor Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 27, 2026, titled "TVS MOTOR COMPANY INTRODUCES TVS ARMADO, A NEW CARGO TRICYCLE".
filings.ns: TVS Motor Company announced the global launch of the TVS Armado, a new cargo tricycle, on November 27, 2026. The vehicle features a 1 ton load capacity and is powered by a 200 cc oil-cooled engine delivering 10.6 kW of maximum power at 7,500 rpm and 15.5 Nm of peak torque at 5,000 rpm. It includes a five-speed manual transmission and a 16-litre fuel tank. The cargo bed is two metres long with 230 mm of ground clearance. TVS Motor Company aims to serve first and last-mile logistics in Africa, Latin America, and ASEAN. The company stated this launch expands its commercial mobility portfolio.

filings.ns: HEG Limited listed its equity shares on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange on November 27, 2026. The listing follows a Composite Scheme of Arrangement approved by the National Company Law Tribunal on August 13, 2026. The scheme took effect on September 1, 2026. Shareholders of HEG Advanced Materials Limited received one fully paid-up equity share of HEG Limited for every share held. The new entity trades under scrip code 544896 on BSE and symbol HEGRAPHITE on NSE. HEG operates a facility in Mandideep with an annual capacity of 100,000 tonnes. The company exports approximately 65 to 70 percent of production to more than 35 countries. The board has approved a Rs 650 crore expansion to increase capacity to 115,000 tonnes per annum by the first quarter of calendar year 2028.

filings.summary: Mastek Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of cancellation of Analyst / Institutional Investor Meet scheduled to be held on November 27,2026'.
filings.ns: Mastek Limited has cancelled the Analyst and Institutional Investor Meet originally scheduled for November 27, 2026, at 12.00 noon. This cancellation follows the company's previous intimation dated November 26, 2026. The notice is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company requests the listing departments of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited to take note of this update.

filings.name: Tanla Platforms Limited
filings.label: Reply to exchange query (volume / price / news)
filings.subject: Clarification/Confirmation on news item appearing in “Media/Publication”
filings.summary: The Exchange has sought clarification from Tanla Platforms Limited with respect to recent news item captioned Tanla Platforms shares plunge 12% in 6 days amid SC's setback for subsidiary Karix Mobile; details about ₹375 cr dispute.  The response from the Company is attached.
filings.ns: Tanla Platforms Limited responded to NSE queries regarding a Livemint article about its subsidiary Karix Mobile. The article cited a Supreme Court setback in Writ Petition No. 1815/2026 concerning a NICSI tender. Tanla clarified the matter was non-commercial, involving only tender process disputes, with no negotiations or settlements. The company assessed the event under SEBI LODR Regulations and concluded no disclosure was required as it did not meet materiality thresholds or involve penalties. Tanla stated the issue had no material impact on the company or its share price. The company confirmed it is unaware of any undisclosed information explaining the recent share price movement. Tanla affirmed compliance with all SEBI LODR disclosure requirements.

filings.name: Netweb Technologies India Limited
filings.label: New product / launch
filings.subject: INTIMATION UNDER REGULATION 30 OF THE SEBI (LISTING OBLIGATIONS AND DISCLOSURE REQUIREMENTS) REGULATIONS, 2015, REGARDING LAUNCH OF NEW PRODUCT
filings.summary: Netweb Technologies India Limited has informed the Exchange about Product launch
filings.ns: Netweb Technologies India Limited has launched a new product named Skylus Workspace on 27.11.2026. The product is categorized as an Enterprise Digital Workspace Platform. It caters to both domestic and international markets. Currently, the product is launched in India. The company filed this intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The filing references a press release dated 27.11.2026. The information is submitted for the records of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The notice was issued by Lohit Chhabra, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
